title: Zesty Irish Fish Paella
description: A quick and flavorful Irish-inspired paella dish featuring fish and a hint of vanilla, cooked to a perfect lacquer-glaze finish in a traditional paella pan.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the cod pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cod from the pan and set aside.
Add the smoked paprika, saffron threads, and vanilla extract to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Arborio rice to the pan and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, salt, and pepper to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Return the cod to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
